lead: Puts a label, a control, a description and an error message together into one form item. Validation, the label association and `aria-describedby` come from Base UI's Field; the examples follow the TextField, Label, Description and FieldError pages of the HeroUI docs.

required.title: Required
required.description: On the Field, `required` only draws the asterisk; the input needs `required` too to take part in validation.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: Native constraint validation: with `validationMode="onBlur"` the input is checked when it loses focus, and each `Field.Error` shows for the error type its `match` names. Try typing an invalid email, then click elsewhere.

controlled-invalid.title: Controlled Invalid
controlled-invalid.description: When you decide validity yourself, control the whole item with `invalid`, and pass `match` to `Field.Error` to decide whether it shows.

variants.title: Variants & Sizes
variants.description: `variant` / `size` on the Field are the defaults of the controls inside.

form.title: A small form
form.description: Several items put together, with a Button at the end.

api.title: API Reference
api.label: The label, associated with the control inside automatically.
api.desc: The description text, added to the control's `aria-describedby` automatically.
api.error: The error message, shown when validation fails by default; `match` picks which validity error it is for, and `true` lets you control it from outside.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle the label, the description and the error message in `field.css`; the asterisk and the red label of an invalid item are driven by the hooks.
styling.required: Present when the Field has `required`; theme styles draw the asterisk with it
styling.states: State hooks, written by Base UI; theme styles turn the label red with `:has([data-invalid])`
